title: Unendowed
summary: UNENDOW'ED, adjective 1. Not endowed; not furnished; not invested; as a man unendowed with virtues. 2. Not furnished with funds; as an unendowed college or hospital.

inlines.v: UNENDOW'ED, adjective 1. Not endowed; not furnished; not invested; as a man unendowed with virtues. 2. Not furnished with funds; as an unendowed college or hospital.
